name: Zan
ingredients: Millets (Finger millet or other local grains)
Seasonal vegetables (such as spinach or mustard greens)
instructions: 1. Boil water in a heavy-bottomed pot.
2. Gradually add millet flour while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
3. Continue cooking on medium heat, stirring frequently until the mixture thickens into a porridge consistency.
4. Add finely chopped seasonal greens, ginger, and chili flakes.
5. If using meat, add pre-cooked or dried meat pieces at this stage.
6. Season with salt and a pinch of ground Sichuan pepper for the signature authentic flavor.
7. Serve hot as a staple meal.
description: Zan is a significant traditional dish of the Monpa tribe of Arunachal Pradesh. It is a wholesome, nutrient-dense porridge that reflects the region's reliance on millets and seasonal vegetables. It is considered a staple comfort food, often consumed to sustain energy levels in the cold, mountainous climate of Tawang and West Kameng districts.
